constants.storedScoreRule: cents = floor((2N + D) / (2D)) with D = n + 1, N = 100*(hi*D - (hi - lo)*(index + 1)); capped at hi*100 - 1 for FINE and DISLIKED; storedScore = cents / 100
constants.nameOrder: Unicode code point, not UTF-16 code unit (SQL collate "C" on UTF-8), then bevId the same way
constants.streakDayKey: calendar date of the ranking instant in the profile timezone: (created_at AT TIME ZONE timezone)::date; week = ISO week of that date (YYYY-Www)
constants.rankOrder: points desc, bevsRanked desc, createdAt asc, userId asc; rank = 1 + count(points > mine); bevsRanked = 0 excluded
constants.treeDepth: Wu-Palmer depth from an implicit root (depth 0) above the top-level categories; a top-level category (parent null or not in the taxonomy) has depth 1
constants.embeddingRule: min(1, max(0, dot / sqrt(|a|^2 * |b|^2))); 0 when either vector is zero
constants.edgeWeightRule: tree*0.25 + content*0.15 + emb*0.30 + profile*0.30 + cop*0, summed in that order, clamped to [0, 1]
constants.edgeOrder: w desc, then bevId asc (code unit); keep w >= edgeMinWeight; at most edgeTopK
constants.pearsonRule: r over common(u, v) = R(u) & R(v) in bevId order: sum((x - mean x)(y - mean y)) / sqrt(sum((x - mean x)^2) * sum((y - mean y)^2)), clamped to [-1, 1]; 0 when |common| < cfMinCommon or either side is constant (all entries equal); sim = r * min(1, |common| / cfSignificance)
constants.tasteAttributeKey: 'category:' + categoryId, 'brand:' + normaliseBrand(brand) when non-empty, 'flavor:' + trim(flavorBase) when non-empty; kept when it covers >= tasteMinAttrBevs catalog Bevs
constants.tasteVectorRule: t_u[a] = sum of z_{u,b} over b in R(u) carrying a / (n_{u,a} + tasteK); Bevs outside the catalog skipped
constants.attributeSimilarityRule: cosine of the taste vectors as sparse vectors (missing = 0), clamped to [-1, 1]; 0 when either is all zeros
constants.sharedAttrsRule: count of attributes a of a tasteBridgeKinds kind with |t_u[a]| >= tasteSharedMin and |t_v[a]| >= tasteSharedMin that u and v reach through distinct Bevs: some b in R(u) and b2 in R(v) carry a with b != b2 (one co-rated Bev is not a bridge)
constants.blendRule: alpha = tasteAlpha if |common| >= cfMinCommon else 0; attributeSim = attributeSimilarity if |common| >= cfMinCommon or sharedAttrs >= tasteMinSharedAttrs else 0; sim = alpha * pearson.sim + (1 - alpha) * attributeSim, clamped to [-1, 1]; method = attr (alpha 0), pearson (alpha 1), else blend
constants.neighbourOrder: sim desc, then userId asc (code point, SQL collate "C"); keep sim >= tasteSimFloor; at most tasteNeighbourK
constants.reliabilityRule: min(1, n_v / neighbourReliabilityN); applied by Layer 2 per neighbour, not stored in user_neighbors.sim
constants.bayesStoredRule: bev_stats.bayes_score numeric(4,2) from exact inputs: m with at most 3 dp (global_stats.mean_score numeric(5,3), or the exact category mean), scores in cents; N = C*m_thousandths + 10*sum(score_cents), D = C + n; storedCents = round half away from zero of N / (10*D) = floor((2N + 10D) / (20D)); never round the floating-point bayes
constants.streakEvents: streakFromTimestamps.timestamps are ranking EVENTS (submit_ranking and rerank_bev), never deleted: a re-rank adds its own day and keeps the original one; a removal adds and deletes nothing. When a case lists input.events, timestamps = events.map(at)
constants.layer1EdgesRule: bevSimilarity 'edges': sim(b, b') = w of the snapshot.edges row for the unordered pair {b, b'} (either orientation), 0 when there is none; pairs with sim < simMin dropped as in 'content'; content = sum(sim * z) / (sum(sim) + 1); conf1 mass = n_{u,cat(b)} + sum(sim); affinity and g unchanged. A snapshot without an edges field (absent or null) uses contentSimilarity ('content'); an empty array means no edges
constants.layer2StoredRule: userSimilarity 'stored' (Stage 4), for the user u: N(u) = snapshot.userNeighbours[u] (u's user_neighbors rows, any order); sim'(u, v) = sim * min(1, n_v / neighbourReliabilityN) for v in N(u), with sim as stored and n_v = users[v].stats.n (derived from v's rankings when v is missing from users; 0 when v is unknown to the snapshot, so the row weighs 0); sim'(u, v) = 0 for every v not in N(u), whatever their co-ratings. Then Layer 2 exactly as in 'cosine' mode: the raters of b other than u with sim' > 0 (so a negative stored sim is dropped), sim' desc then userId asc, at most cfK; support = sum(sim'); z2 = sum(sim' * z_{v,b}) / support, 0 without neighbours. common is carried and read by no formula. Falls back to 'cosine' (the in-snapshot sim' of section 8.9) when the snapshot has no userNeighbours field (absent or null) or u has no rows (key missing or empty list). source = the similarity actually used. predictScore: lambda and confidence read this support
constants.placementTiersRule: tier of a bucket Bev l relative to the new Bev b (placementTier constants): sameLeaf (1) when categoryId (the root) is equal and both leafCategoryId are non-null and equal; sameRoot (2) when categoryId is equal otherwise (a null leaf on either side, i.e. kind unknown, never reaches tier 1); edge (3) when the roots differ and weights[l.id] (the bev_edges w of {b, l}) is >= edgeMinWeight; null otherwise (no weight, or a weight below the floor). Without weights only tiers 1 and 2 occur
constants.anchoredPlacementRule: startPlacement with tiers (one per orderedBevIds entry, filtered with the Bev itself): anchors A = the entries other than bevId whose tier equals the smallest non-null tier among the entries other than bevId (on a re-rank the Bev is still in the list and its tier against itself is ignored), in list order, at positions p_1 < ... < p_k of the filtered list; no anchors = the plain search. Phase 1 = binary search over anchor slots [aLo, aHi] = [0, k]: ask a_j with j = floor((aLo + aHi) / 2) (0-based), NEW_BETTER aHi = j, EXISTING_BETTER aLo = j + 1, TIE ends the placement at p_j + 1; after each answer the insertion range is lo = (aLo = 0 ? 0 : p_{aLo - 1} + 1), hi = (aHi = k ? n : p_{aHi}). Phase 2 = the plain search on [lo, hi] once aLo = aHi (none when lo = hi). insertIndex = lo; comparisons in the order asked; maxSteps = maxComparisons(k) + maxComparisons(widest gap between consecutive anchors, or before the first / after the last), constant. Undo restores lo, hi, aLo, aHi
constants.networkGraphRule: undirected weighted graph { nodes, edges: [{ a, b, w }] }; throws on a duplicate or empty node id, an endpoint not in nodes, a self-loop, a duplicate unordered pair (either orientation), a non-finite w or w <= 0. Nodes are processed in code-point order (SQL collate "C"), each node's neighbours in that order, so results do not depend on the order of nodes or edges or on edge orientation. strength s_i = sum of w over the neighbours in order; m = (sum of s_i in node order) / 2
constants.pageRankRule: start p_j = 1/n; each iteration, for j in node order: acc = sum over neighbours i of j in order of (p_i * w_ij) / s_i; D = sum of p_i over isolated nodes (s_i = 0) in node order; p'_j = (1 - d)/n + d * (acc + D/n); stop when sum_j |p'_j - p_j| (node order) < tolerance or after maxIterations iterations; return p' / sum(p') (node order). Defaults d = pagerankDamping, tolerance = pagerankTolerance, maxIterations = pagerankMaxIterations; at the fixed point a lone isolated node holds (1 - d)/(n - d)
constants.modularityRule: Q = sum over community labels ascending of (W_c / m - gamma * (S_c / (2m))^2); W_c = weight of edges with both ends in c (each edge once, from its smaller endpoint, node order), S_c = sum of members' s_i in node order; m = 0 gives 0; labels are any integers, every node needs one, extra keys ignored; gamma defaults to louvainResolution
constants.louvainRule: level 0: every node its own community; visit nodes in code-point order in passes until a full pass moves nothing. Visiting i: remove it from its community; gain(C) = k_{i,C}/m - gamma * S_C * k_i / (2m^2) (k_{i,C} = i's weight into C over its neighbours in order, S_C = C's strength without i, k_i = i's strength incl. twice its internal weight); candidates in order: its own (possibly emptied) community first, then each neighbouring community by ascending representative (the community's smallest member id, code point); a candidate replaces the best only if its gain exceeds the best by more than louvainTieEpsilon, so a tie keeps i where it is. Then each community becomes a super-node (its internal weight kept as a self-loop, counted in k but not in k_{i,C}; its id for ordering is its representative) and the next level runs; stop at the first level that moves nothing. Output: communities = member lists in code-point order, sorted by size desc then first member asc; communityOf[id] = index in communities; modularity = modularity(graph, communityOf, gamma). No edges: all singletons, modularity 0
constants.participationRule: P_i = 1 - sum over labels ascending of (s_{i,c} / s_i)^2, s_{i,c} = i's weight into community c (its own included) over its neighbours in order, the order s_i is summed in (so a node whose neighbours all share its community is exactly 0); isolated node 0; clamped at 0 below; in [0, 1)
constants.communityHubRule: hub of a community = the member with the greatest within-community strength (weight to the other members, over its neighbours in order), compared as exact doubles, ties to the smallest id (code point); a singleton is its own hub; keyed by community label. The hub identifies the community: the graph sync derives the community's opaque public id from it (hashed, so an age-gated hub's Bev id never reaches a client)
constants.attributeProjectionRule: one-mode projection of a bipartite node-attribute graph { nodes, memberships: [{ node, attribute }] }, Adamic-Adar weighted: w_ab = sum over attributes x carried by both a and b of 1 / ln(deg(x)), deg(x) = number of distinct nodes carrying x, each term computed as 1 / Math.log(deg). Throws on a duplicate or empty node id, an empty attribute, a membership whose node is not in nodes, or a duplicate (node, attribute) row. An attribute with deg 1 is skipped (joins nothing). Attributes are processed in code-point order, each attribute's nodes in code-point order, and each pair's weight is accumulated from 0 in that attribute order. Output nodes in code-point order; edges oriented a < b (code point), sorted by (a, b), only for pairs sharing at least one attribute with deg >= 2; a node sharing nothing stays in nodes with no edge. The result is a valid graph for networkGraphRule. No constant: the caller chooses the attributes (the graph sync passes flavor:<base> and note:<token>, leaving out the base other), and the sync stores community = the Louvain community of this projection (the taste family)
